title: Micron buys $1 billion of Anthropic stock in IPO private placement

sources.quote: (“Micron”) will purchase 12,048,192 shares of our Class N common stock for approximately $1.0 billion, Microsoft Corporation (“Microsoft”) will purchase 12,048,192 shares of our Class N common stock for approximately $1.0 billion, and TSMC Partners, Ltd.

explain: Alongside Anthropic's stock-market debut, Micron agreed to buy about $1 billion of Anthropic's Class N shares at the IPO price, in a private placement that closes right after the offering.
